guide.title: Fixture: Below Link Floor
guide.intro: This intro clears the ninety word floor deliberately, so that the only rule this fixture breaks is the outbound link one. An orientation page earns its place by pointing a reader onward, and the link floor is what makes that concrete rather than aspirational. The prose here is filler with a purpose: it exists to be long enough that the word count branch of the floor helper cannot fire, which is the whole point of a fixture that violates exactly one rule at a time. Were it any shorter, the word rule would fire first and the link rule below it would never be reported, and a test asserting the link rule would be proving the word rule instead. That is the exact defect these two complementary fixtures were written to close.
